Tuesday Training Ride (Lancaster Bicycle Club)

Lancaster, PA

Tuesday Training Ride (Lancaster Bicycle Club) is a road group ride in Lancaster, PA. It meets Tuesdays, 6:00 pm, starting at Calvary Church. Expect about 25 miles, A (18–20 mph) and A+ (20–22 mph) groups.

About the Tuesday Training Ride (Lancaster Bicycle Club) group ride

A show-and-go 25-mile training loop with no designated leader. Fast pacelining; riders who can't hold the pace may be dropped. E-bikes not recommended. The club runs slower no-drop rides on the same evenings; the full schedule lives on Meetup.
